scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run wait:api && npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: npm run predev && npm run dev --prefix backend
scripts.dev:frontend: npm run wait:api && npm run dev --prefix frontend
scripts.start: npm run predev && concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run wait:api && npm run preview --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install
